prose: windows: when it's going to spin up another, the act of spinning it up should either exit or close the other. what needs to be a singleton per cairn? cairn itself across all boxes. maybe codemother. but on an individual host, that would be the ground loop, the bus, the rack, there can't be two akienasus_cc_0 on the same bus! that would be akienasus_cc_1... the original intentions had something about this. maybe we should check there... but in short, we need to be taking that kind of thing into account
